generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document.

technicalCriterionList.description: Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

Bidder(Civil Contractor) should have satisfactorily completed at least one similar nature of work of value not less than 50 Percent of the amount put to tender during the preceding 5 years from 2020-2025 (work done certificate should be obtained from Government & Recognized Private authority)
A copy of the KPWD with valid Class II &AboveContractor registration certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- A copy of the KPWD with valid Class II &AboveContractor registration certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall compulsorily be enrolled in Rajya Vokkaligara Sangha as a contractor. For new enrollment contact Estate officer/Engineer In-Charge, RVS.

technicalCriterionList.description: The annual turnover should be at least equivalent to twice the amount put to tender respectively in any of the two financial years during the last 5 years reckoned back from 2020-2021(Financial year) The annual turnover of pervious years shall be updated to 2024-2025.(submit detailed IT Returns in that only contract related receipts accepted in the detailed amount mentioned in the IT returns certified by the charted account)

Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only) in each year of Rs. 66.00 Lakhs. (Contract Receipts)
